result:
If I could change the world in just one way, I’d like to instill a deeper, more profound sense of empathy in everyone. Not just a fleeting moment of sympathy or a brief willingness to listen, but rather an ingrained ability to see from someone else’s point of view, understand their struggles, and care about their well-being as thoroughly as one cares for one’s own. 

From that place of genuine empathy, the political divides might soften, conflicts could be approached without dehumanizing the “other,” and collaboration might transform into something more authentic and purposeful—guided by a collective desire to make life better for every individual rather than to score points. It wouldn’t magically fix every issue overnight, but I believe it would make spaces for more meaningful conversations, for bridging divides, and for rediscovering the shared humanity that can bring people together, even in complex times.
